items.title: An AI agent in "Skynet mode" hijacks unprotected language models to launch self-sustaining cyberattacks
items.summary: Security researchers at Symantec have found an offensive AI agent that hijacks unprotected language models on the web and uses them to attack servers, steal databases, and install cryptominers on its own. It runs up to 100,000 steps without human input. The owner of the hijacked model gets stuck with the bill. The article An AI agent in "Skynet mode" hijacks unprotected language models to launch self-sustaining cyberattacks appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: 賽門鐵克（Symantec）的安全研究人員發現了一個具攻擊性的 AI 代理程式，它會劫持網路上的未保護語言模型，並利用這些模型來攻擊伺服器、竊取資料庫以及自行安裝加密貨幣挖礦程式。它能在沒有人工幹預的情況下執行高達 10萬 個步驟。被劫持模型的擁有者卻得被迫承擔這筆帳單。本文「An AI agent in "Skynet mode" hijacks unprotected language models to launch self-sustaining cyberattacks」最初發布於 The Decoder。

items.title: Anthropic takes on Grok Bot, Meta's Muse, and OpenAI's Dots with its always-on agent "Claude Duet"
items.summary: Anthropic has launched Claude Duet, a proactive AI agent that handles tasks on its own, even when the user is offline. The app is built on Claude Opus 5.5 and connects to services like Gmail, Slack, and Stripe through more than 6,000 connectors. It asks for approval before sensitive actions like payments. With Duet, Anthropic is responding to similar products from xAI, Meta, and OpenAI. The article Anthropic takes on Grok Bot, Meta's Muse, and OpenAI's Dots with its always-on agent "Claude Duet" appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: Anthropic 推出了 Claude Duet，這是一個主動式 AI 代理，即使在使用者離線時也能自行處理任務。該應用程式建立在 Claude Opus 5.5 之上，並透過 6,000 多個連接器連線至 Gmail、Slack 和 Stripe 等服務。它會在進行付款等敏感操作之前徵求批准。透過 Duet，Anthropic 正在回應來自 xAI、Meta 和 OpenAI 的類似產品。文章 Anthropic takes on Grok Bot, Meta's Muse, and OpenAI's Dots with its always-on agent "Claude Duet" appeared first on The Decoder .

items.title: 防範AI代理越界行為，NIST提出事件應變指引
items.summary: 10月16日美國國家標準暨技術研究院（NIST）與國家安全局（NSA）、網路安全暨基礎設施安全局（CISA）共同發布10項AI代理事件應變建議，協助組織防範及處理AI代理的越界行為。這份自願性指引主要針對訓練及評估高度先進AI代理的組織，相關措施也可供部署這類AI代理的組織參考。NIST將指引內容分為準備、偵測、應變、復原及通報5個階段。

items.title: Salesforce臺灣將邁入第二年，觀察：AI Agent導入從試點走向企業流程，軟體使用入口正隨AI轉變
items.summary: Salesforce臺灣辦公室成立即將滿一年，Salesforce臺灣總經理徐嘉聲對外分享過去一年的發展，他表示，Salesforce全球策略的核心，是協助企業走向更具Agentic特性的企業。 他指出，Salesforce臺灣今年客戶與營收皆有明顯成長，臺灣的營收及新增客戶數皆達雙位數成長，團隊規模較初期成長5倍。目前企業最關注的方向，就是Agent與資料基礎建設，包括如何讓Agent理解企業資料，以及如何整合Salesforce內外部資料來源。 目前Agentforce與Data 360相關匯入已佔臺灣新簽案件四成。反映企業AI應用正在從單純測試工具，轉向結合企業資料、流程與業務場景的應用模式。

items.title: OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol and Google's Gemini 4 Argon found critical PHP flaw affecting millions of websites
items.summary: OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol discovered a critical PHP vulnerability as part of the Patch the Planet initiative that could affect millions of websites. Security firm Wiz independently found the same flaw using Google's Gemini 4 Argon. OpenAI warns that the same AI capabilities that find vulnerabilities can help attackers too. The article OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol and Google's Gemini 4 Argon found critical PHP flaw affecting millions of websites appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol 作為「修復全球」（Patch the Planet）計畫的一部分，發現了一個可能影響數百萬網站的重大 PHP 漏洞。安全公司 Wiz 利用 Google's Gemini 4 Argon 獨立發現了相同的漏洞。OpenAI 警告稱，能尋找漏洞的相同 AI 能力也可能協助攻擊者。這篇題為「OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol 與 Google's Gemini 4 Argon 發現影響數百萬網站的重大 PHP 漏洞」的文章首先出現在 The Decoder 上。

items.title: Deepmind founder Hassabis shortens AGI timeline from five to two to three years
items.summary: Demis Hassabis keeps moving up his AGI timeline. The Nobel laureate and former Google Deepmind CEO now expects artificial general intelligence within two to three years, down from three to five years earlier this year. The article Deepmind founder Hassabis shortens AGI timeline from five to two to three years appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: Demis Hassabis 不斷提前他的 AGI 時間表。這位諾貝爾獎得主兼前 Google Deepmind 執行長現在預期人工通用智慧將在兩到三年內實現，低於今年稍早預估的三到五年。這篇 Deepmind 創辦人 Hassabis 將 AGI 時間表從五年縮短至兩到三年的文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

items.title: Inception's Mercury 3 diffusion model claims to beat GPT-6 Luna and Claude Haiku 5.5 at a fraction of the wait
items.summary: Inception says Mercury 3 is the most capable diffusion language model released so far. The company claims it runs four to eight times faster than GPT-6 Luna and Claude Haiku 5.5 and beats both in eight of 12 benchmarks. There are no independent tests yet. The article Inception's Mercury 3 diffusion model claims to beat GPT-6 Luna and Claude Haiku 5.5 at a fraction of the wait appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: Inception 表示，Mercury 3 是迄今為止最強大的擴散語言模型。該公司宣稱其運行速度比 GPT-6 Luna 和 Claude Haiku 5.5 快 4 到 8 倍，並在 12 個基準測試中的 8 個中超越兩者。目前尚無獨立測試。這篇題為《Inception's Mercury 3 diffusion model claims to beat GPT-6 Luna and Claude Haiku 5.5 at a fraction of the wait》的文章首先出現在 The Decoder 上。

items.title: 王興興給宇樹畫了三條線：量產、小模型、大算力
items.summary: 2026世界物理AI大會暨宇樹合作伙伴生態大會在杭州召開。宇樹科技董事長王興興將公司未來打法拆爲三條線：一是產能，強調提升機器人規模量產能力，瞄準千萬級乃至億級市場，從“能造幾臺”走向“能造幾百萬臺”，以規模作護城河；二是走“自研+合作”的複合路徑。

items.title: 訊飛星火 X2.6 端雲一體大模型發佈，首次基於全國產算力突破代碼與智能體能力
items.summary: 科大訊飛在全球1024開發者節發佈訊飛星火X2.6端雲一體大模型，首次基於全國產算力，同時實現代碼與智能體能力。董事長劉慶峯稱，大模型公司中僅星火純用全國產算力訓練，其餘幾乎依賴英偉達，且訊飛模型尺寸最小。爲提升國產算力效率，訊飛正持續優化。

items.title: 英偉達砸錢鎖定供應鏈，拉 6 傢伙伴擴 AI 產能
items.summary: 英偉達10月21日宣佈，與六家供應鏈夥伴全球擴產，以承接加速計算和全棧AI工廠平臺持續增長的需求。六筆合作半數以上聚焦基板環節，計劃未來三年將所需基板產能擴至當前2.5倍。日本揖斐電獲數十億美元預付款，用於擴建日本小野工廠，新增產能約爲現有兩倍，預計2028年。

items.title: Perplexity and NVIDIA Researchers Introduce JOLT: a Joint Teacher-Student Reinforcement Learning Method
items.summary: Perplexity and NVIDIA introduced JOLT, a post-training method that trains one model as both teacher and student. On MATH it matched GRPO’s accuracy with 6.5x fewer processed training tokens. The post Perplexity and NVIDIA Researchers Introduce JOLT: a Joint Teacher-Student Reinforcement Learning Method appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items.summary_zh: Perplexity 與 輝達 推出了 JOLT，這是一種訓練單一模型兼具教師與學生身分的後訓練方法。在 MATH 基準測試中，它以少 6.5 倍的訓練處理代幣數量達到了與 GRPO 相同的準確度。這篇貼文 Perplexity 與 輝達 Researchers Introduce JOLT: a Joint Teacher-Student Reinforcement Learning Method 最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

items.summary: 特斯拉三季度資本支出47.3億美元，同比翻倍以上，但環比少約10億美元，遠低於分析師預期的79.5億美元。公司同時將2026年資本支出目標從逾250億美元下調至約200億美元，降幅近20%。不過，當季自由現金流約15.3億美元，明顯好於市場預期的負值，短期財務表現反而改善。

items.title: PHP 爆出"PHP2Shell"高危漏洞：影響約七成網站，OpenAI 牽頭全球協防
items.summary: OpenAI 21日稱，借“修補地球”計劃協助發現PHP兩項嚴重漏洞，並聯合維護方、安全公司、雲商及多國網安機構，公開前協調修復約兩個月。漏洞統稱“PHP2Shell”，編號CVE-2026-109618、109619，CVSS v4.0均達9.2。Calif用GPT-5.6 Sol發現一關鍵缺陷，谷歌Wiz獨立上報，PHP官方維護者主導修復。

items.title: 通用汽車押注 AI 與富鋰錳基電池：要把電動車研發週期砍半
items.summary: 美國電動車市場劇烈調整，通用汽車卻逆風加註。總裁馬可·睿思21日重申，通用不會退出電動車賽道，將推出更符合美國人口味的產品並提升競爭力。其底氣是全球每售四輛車就有一輛電動車，且比例將升。他強調通用作爲全球企業不會離場，只會擁抱趨勢，並在電池、電動平臺、軟件等領域佈局。

items.title: 特斯拉加州工廠正式量產Optimus機器人，高額AI支出致第三季度利潤大跌43%

items.title: Recursive Releases Flint, an Open-Weight 40B MoE Local Coding Model for Agents with 2.5B Active Params
items.summary: Recursive has released Flint, an Apache 2.0 local coding model with 40B total and 2.5B active parameters. It reports 74.2% on SWE-bench Verified and 125+ tokens per second on an M4 Pro MacBook Pro. The post Recursive Releases Flint, an Open-Weight 40B MoE Local Coding Model for Agents with 2.5B Active Params appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items.summary_zh: Recursive發布了Flint，這是一款採用Apache 2.0授權的本地程式碼模型，擁有400億總參數以及25億活躍參數。它在SWE-bench Verified上獲得74.2%的表現，並在M4 Pro MacBook Pro上達到每秒125個以上的token。這篇文章 Recursive Releases Flint, an Open-Weight 40B MoE Local Coding Model for Agents with 2.5B Active Params 最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

items.title: Vercel Open-Sources durable-harness for Crash-Proof Coding Agents
items.summary: Vercel released durable-harness, an open-source package that logs every model and tool call so Pi, OpenCode, Claude Code and Codex sessions resume after crashes, timeouts and redeploys on Vercel, Postgres or a laptop. The post Vercel Open-Sources durable-harness for Crash-Proof Coding Agents appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items.summary_zh: Vercel發布了durable-harness，這是一個開源軟體包，能記錄每一個模型和工具呼叫，讓Pi、OpenCode、Claude Code和Codex工作階段在Vercel、Postgres或筆記型電腦上發生當機、逾時和重新部署後能夠恢復。這篇文章 Vercel Open-Sources durable-harness for Crash-Proof Coding Agents 最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

items_ai.title: An AI agent in "Skynet mode" hijacks unprotected language models to launch self-sustaining cyberattacks
items_ai.summary: Security researchers at Symantec have found an offensive AI agent that hijacks unprotected language models on the web and uses them to attack servers, steal databases, and install cryptominers on its own. It runs up to 100,000 steps without human input. The owner of the hijacked model gets stuck with the bill. The article An AI agent in "Skynet mode" hijacks unprotected language models to launch self-sustaining cyberattacks appeared first on The Decoder .
items_ai.summary_zh: 賽門鐵克（Symantec）的安全研究人員發現了一個具攻擊性的 AI 代理程式，它會劫持網路上的未保護語言模型，並利用這些模型來攻擊伺服器、竊取資料庫以及自行安裝加密貨幣挖礦程式。它能在沒有人工幹預的情況下執行高達 10萬 個步驟。被劫持模型的擁有者卻得被迫承擔這筆帳單。本文「An AI agent in "Skynet mode" hijacks unprotected language models to launch self-sustaining cyberattacks」最初發布於 The Decoder。

items_ai.title: Anthropic takes on Grok Bot, Meta's Muse, and OpenAI's Dots with its always-on agent "Claude Duet"
items_ai.summary: Anthropic has launched Claude Duet, a proactive AI agent that handles tasks on its own, even when the user is offline. The app is built on Claude Opus 5.5 and connects to services like Gmail, Slack, and Stripe through more than 6,000 connectors. It asks for approval before sensitive actions like payments. With Duet, Anthropic is responding to similar products from xAI, Meta, and OpenAI. items_ai.title: Perplexity and NVIDIA Researchers Introduce JOLT: a Joint Teacher-Student Reinforcement Learning Method
items_ai.summary: Perplexity and NVIDIA introduced JOLT, a post-training method that trains one model as both teacher and student. On MATH it matched GRPO’s accuracy with 6.5x fewer processed training tokens. The post Perplexity and NVIDIA Researchers Introduce JOLT: a Joint Teacher-Student Reinforcement Learning Method appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_ai.summary_zh: Perplexity 與 輝達 推出了 JOLT，這是一種訓練單一模型兼具教師與學生身分的後訓練方法。在 MATH 基準測試中，它以少 6.5 倍的訓練處理代幣數量達到了與 GRPO 相同的準確度。這篇貼文 Perplexity 與 輝達 Researchers Introduce JOLT: a Joint Teacher-Student Reinforcement Learning Method 最初發表於 MarkTechPost。
